div.div: عَقَبَةٌ كَؤُودٌ , (S, L, K,) and ↓ كَأْدَآءُ , (L, K,) A mountain-road difficult of ascent. (S, L, K. *) Such a road is also termed [simply] كَأْدَآءُ, and صُعَدَآءُ: [in the K it is said, that كُؤَدَآءُ is syn. with صُعَدَآءُ:] and كَؤُودٌ [in like manner, as a subst.,] signifies. a difficult place of ascent: like صَعُودٌ. (L, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
